description: The external origins Disc Player may reach, added to its Content-Security-Policy by the service (the app's own origins.json, combined-009). Reviewed in this repository: a provider is added or removed with a release of the app, never of the server. Without this file the page stays same-origin.

musicbrainz.purpose: Release and recording metadata (MusicBrainz web service, JSON).

coverartarchive.purpose: Front covers by MusicBrainz release id.

archive_root.purpose: Cover Art Archive answers every image with a redirect to archive.org/download, which redirects again to a download host.

archive.purpose: The Internet Archive's download hosts holding Cover Art Archive images, read as bytes (covers are drawn on a canvas) and shown.

lrclib.purpose: Synchronised lyrics by artist, title, album and duration.

wikidata.purpose: An artist's image (property P18) when MusicBrainz links Wikidata but no image.

commons.purpose: Image information of an artist's photo on Wikimedia Commons: its thumbnail, author and licence.

wikimedia_upload.purpose: The artist photo's thumbnail itself, read as bytes (drawn on a canvas).

wikimedia_thumb.purpose: Commons now serves an image's thumbnails from this host; the artist photo's thumbnail is read as bytes.

fanart_api.purpose: Artist photos, wide backgrounds and album covers by MusicBrainz id (fanart.tv API v3), asked with the owner's personal key once the owner allowed the source.

fanart_assets.purpose: fanart.tv's images and their small previews, read as bytes and drawn on a canvas.

jsdelivr.purpose: AutoEq's headphone corrections (github.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq at the revision the page pins): the results index and a headphone's fixed-band file, read as text once the owner allowed the source.

lrcred.purpose: Lyrics with word timings (lrc.red): a search by the track's artist and title, and a result's LRC file, read as text once the owner allowed the source.

listenbrainz_api.purpose: ListenBrainz's popularity by MusicBrainz id (an artist's most listened recordings and release groups), read as JSON once the owner allowed the source; only ids are sent.

listenbrainz_labs.purpose: ListenBrainz Labs' similarity by MusicBrainz id (similar artists and recordings), read as JSON once the owner allowed the source; only ids are sent.
